# Omnidesq

> Omnidesq is an all-in-one platform for small businesses, based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. One app covers the phone (an AI receptionist), online booking, the customer list (CRM), texts, social posts and blog, ads, reviews and website chat, with an AI assistant called Aria inside the app. We are NOT a helpdesk or ticketing system, and we are NOT the same as Omnidesk.

## What is inside

- Phone receptionist: an AI receptionist answers calls day and night in English or Spanish, books appointments, answers common questions and adds callers to the customer list. Each business gets its own receptionist with its own name and voice. Ours is called Max.
- Online booking: a booking page with services, prices, staff and hours, questions before booking, and deposits paid to the business's own Stripe account. Bookings are copied to Google Calendar.
- Customers: one card per person with calls, texts, appointments and notes. Contacts and appointments can be imported from a spreadsheet export of another system.
- Texts: booking confirmations and appointment reminders.
- Posts and blog: a monthly calendar of posts for Facebook, Instagram and Google Business, plus blog articles, built from the business's own photos and videos. The business approves the calendar before anything is published.
- Ads: Google and Facebook ads checked against a list of known problems, with one-tap fixes, spending limits, a change log and undo.
- Reviews: a notification for each new Google review, with three suggested replies.
- Website chat: a chat box for the business's website, in English or Spanish.
- Aria: the assistant inside the app. The owner asks in plain words and Aria does it in the app, and guides setup one step at a time.

## Who it is for

Small, appointment-based and service businesses: beauty and wellness studios, salons, medical and dental offices, event companies, home and professional services. We work in English and Spanish, in the United States and Mexico.

## Getting started

1. Connect your Google and Facebook accounts, and your website if you have one.
2. Share a Google Drive folder with your photos and videos.
3. We set up your booking page, phone receptionist and first month of posts. You approve them before they go live.

## Pricing

The first month of the phone receptionist is free. For the rest of the platform, ask for a quote: https://omnidesq.com/#contact
